captions.detailed: A compact cylindrical macro lens consisting of a matte black main barrel with a thin red accent ring at its base. It features a wide, ribbed black focus ring capable of continuous rotation, and a dark grey inner extension barrel that extends linearly from the front, revealing a dark blue reflective glass lens element.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a macro lens with a cylindrical body, a thin red decorative ring, a ribbed focus ring configured with a revolute joint, and an inner extension barrel containing a blue glass lens element configured with a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: Construct a base cylinder for the main barrel, adding a thin red cylinder at the rear for the accent ring. Create the focus ring by subtracting a pattern of small grooves from a cylinder, then link it to the base using a revolute joint. Build the inner extension barrel as a nested cylinder with a blue-colored disc for the glass lens, and attach it to the main barrel using a prismatic joint.
